preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 400,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index in the edges is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(x in {0, 1} for x in result)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: result[i] == 1 if can_make_centroid(i + 1, edges) else result[i] == 0
postconditions.description: The i-th integer is 1 if the (i+1)-th vertex can be made a centroid by replacing no more than one edge, otherwise 0.
